description: List the event's sessions (up to 200), optionally filtered by status, track, or scheduled/unscheduled. Use it to scan the program or find a sessionId; use get_session for one session in full and get_agenda for the timetable. Returns sessions[] with title, status, type, format, time, room, track, and speaker names, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

scheduled.description: true → only sessions with a scheduled time; false → only unscheduled.

status.description: Filter by session status (e.g. proposed, accepted, confirmed, rejected).

trackId.description: Filter to one track (id from list_sessions rows or the event overview).

name: list_sessions

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end time, or null when unscheduled.

speakerNames.description: Names of the people on the session.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start time, or null when unscheduled.

status.description: Session status, e.g. proposed, accepted, confirmed, rejected.

type.description: Session type, e.g. talk, keynote, panel, workshop.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
